description: This Java class 'AlarmCommentTriggerProcessor' implements notification trigger processing for alarm comment events within the Thingsboard platform. It handles filtering alarm comment triggers based on various criteria and constructs notification info objects for alarm comment events.

classes.name: AlarmCommentTriggerProcessor
classes.description: Implements processing of alarm comment triggers, including filtering and notification info construction.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Determines if a given alarm comment trigger matches the specified trigger configuration based on comment type, alarm types, severities, and statuses.

methods.name: constructNotificationInfo
methods.description: Builds a notification info object containing details about the alarm comment event, including alarm and user details.

methods.name: getTriggerType
methods.description: Returns the trigger type associated with alarm comments.
